factual_claims.source_evidence: Overview sections for each business unit state: AS LHV Pank net profit EUR 24.3 million, LHV Bank Limited net profit EUR 1.4 million, AS LHV Varahaldus net profit EUR 0.4 million, AS LHV Kindlustus net profit EUR 0.8 million. factual_claims.claim: Overall, despite higher loan impairment provisions and a challenging external geopolitical background, the company demonstrated solid underlying revenue growth, driven primarily by strong net interest income performance and successful technological infrastructure upgrades.
